segments.text: An AI learned to tell wolves from huskies, and it was almost always right.
segments.caption: An AI learned to tell wolves from huskies, and it was almost always right.

segments.text: Then researchers checked what it was looking at. Not the animal. The snow.
segments.caption: Then researchers checked what it was looking at. Not the animal. The snow.

segments.text: Every wolf photo had snow behind it. The AI picked the wrong clue. Today: how to pick the right ones.

segments.text: Day six of 100 Days of Machine Learning: features and labels.
segments.caption: Day 6 of 100 Days of Machine Learning: features and labels.

segments.text: Here's the textbook definition, the one to use in interviews. Features are the input variables a model uses to make a prediction. The label, also called the target, is the output it learns to predict.
segments.caption: Here's the textbook definition, the one to use in interviews. Features are the input variables a model uses to make a prediction. The label, also called the target, is the output it learns to predict.

segments.text: In plain words: features are the clues, the label is the answer.
segments.caption: In plain words: features are the clues, the label is the answer.

segments.text: Every model has this pair.
segments.caption: Every model has this pair.

segments.text: Swiggy delivery time: distance, rain and traffic are features. The minutes taken is the label.
segments.caption: Swiggy delivery time: distance, rain and traffic are features. The minutes taken is the label.

segments.text: A spam filter: links, words like free, and the sender are features. Spam or not is the label.
segments.caption: A spam filter: links, words like free, and the sender are features. Spam or not is the label.

segments.text: And our example today: will a student pass? Hours studied and attendance are features. Pass or fail is the label.
segments.caption: And our example today: will a student pass? Hours studied and attendance are features. Pass or fail is the label.

segments.text: It's like a doctor. Fever, cough and test results are the features. The diagnosis is the label. Better clues, better diagnosis.
segments.caption: It's like a doctor. Fever, cough and test results are the features. The diagnosis is the label. Better clues, better diagnosis.

segments.text: But not every clue is a good one. Here are five tests every feature must pass.
segments.caption: But not every clue is a good one. Here are 5 tests every feature must pass.

segments.text: Test one: would you know it before you predict?
segments.caption: Test 1: would you know it before you predict?

segments.text: Imagine predicting pass or fail using re-exam fee paid. Only students who failed pay it. The model looks brilliant, but it's reading the answer. This is called data leakage.
segments.caption: Imagine predicting pass or fail using re-exam fee paid. Only students who failed pay it. The model looks brilliant, but it's reading the answer. This is called data leakage.

segments.text: Test two: is it actually related?
segments.caption: Test 2: is it actually related?

segments.text: Roll number has nothing to do with passing. But with enough data, the model finds fake patterns in it. If there's no real reason it matters, leave it out.
segments.caption: Roll number has nothing to do with passing. But with enough data, the model finds fake patterns in it. If there's no real reason it matters, leave it out.

segments.text: Test three: is it a duplicate?
segments.caption: Test 3: is it a duplicate?

segments.text: Study hours per day and study hours per week say the same thing twice. The model can't tell which one matters. Keep one.
segments.caption: Study hours per day and study hours per week say the same thing twice. The model can't tell which one matters. Keep one.

segments.text: Test four: does it change?
segments.caption: Test 4: does it change?

segments.text: If every student is from the same school, the school column is identical in every row. A clue that never changes can't explain anything.
segments.caption: If every student is from the same school, the school column is identical in every row. A clue that never changes can't explain anything.

segments.text: Test five: is it fair?
segments.caption: Test 5: is it fair?

segments.text: Never use caste, religion or gender to decide things like loans or admissions, even if they seem to help. And watch for hidden stand-ins, like a pin code.
segments.caption: Never use caste, religion or gender to decide things like loans or admissions, even if they seem to help. And watch for hidden stand-ins, like a pin code.

segments.text: And the best features are often built, not found. Date of birth becomes age. Login times become late night study.
segments.caption: And the best features are often built, not found. Date of birth becomes age. Login times become late night study.

segments.text: So remember: the label is the answer, features are the clues, and every clue must be known in time, related, not a duplicate, changing, and fair.
segments.caption: So remember: the label is the answer, features are the clues, and every clue must be known in time, related, not a duplicate, changing, and fair.
